table.title: Equivalent R and SPSS syntax
rows:
df <- read.csv("review-survey.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c('', 'NA', 'null', 'NULL'))
library(survival)
df$.y <- as.integer(as.numeric(df$chosen) > 0)
attrs <- c("color", "size")
dummies <- NULL
for (col in attrs) {
  lev <- sort(unique(as.character(df[[col]])))
  if (length(lev) < 2) next
  for (lv in lev[-1]) {
    nm <- paste0(col, '=', lv)
    dummies <- cbind(dummies, as.numeric(as.character(df[[col]]) == lv))
    colnames(dummies)[ncol(dummies)] <- nm
  }
}
df$.id <- df[["profile"]]
X <- as.data.frame(dummies)
X$y <- df$.y
X$id <- df$.id
fit <- clogit(y ~ . - id + strata(id), data=X)
cf <- coef(fit)
cat(sprintf('u1=%.16g\n', unname(cf[1])))
